name: Upward Bound
what_you_do: Get one on one advising from an advisor at your school, go to Saturday sessions, and get help with college and financial aid forms. In summer, students can join the Summer Academy at SDSU and live in the dorms.
grades: Grades 9 to 12 (Summer Academy 2025 was for rising 10th to 12th graders)
who_can_apply: Low income or first generation students at one of 9 partner high schools: Castle Park, Mar Vista, Southwest, Crawford, Hoover, San Diego High, El Cajon Valley, Morse and Mount Miguel.
pay_detail: The program is 100% federally funded. The Summer Academy page says students get paid, but no amount is stated.
duration: School year advising plus a summer academy
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. The page links an interest form and an online application. The Summer Academy page still says to check back for 2026 registration.
how_to_apply: If you go to a partner school, fill out the interest form (in English or Spanish) or the online application linked at the bottom of the Upward Bound page, or see the advisor at your campus. Questions: 619-594-6184 or upwardboundite@sdsu.edu.
notes: In July 2025 the Summer Academy had students stay in freshman dorms, go to lectures and do a research project on a public health issue in their community. The Summer Academy page also mentions work study internships for rising 12th graders and pre-internships for rising 11th graders.
